# Threshold Medical
A lot of things when it comes to medical work differently in the Threshold, if you were expecting something to heal in one way but it's not working as you expected, then these differences may very well be to blame!\n
[color=burlywood]In general it is more difficult to get people healed up in the Threshold![/color] \n That means you may have to be more careful with how you handle danger. The guidebook entries attached to this one will tell you more about what changes the Threshold has caused to our healing.
